context.note: DEP-008 §2.6 hostile egress-BYPASS corpus. Extends the DAT-005 default-deny classifier (server/src/services/egress-policy.ts classifyEgressDestination) with adversarial SSRF/rebind spellings a managed sandbox must never let through: hex-mapped IPv4-in-IPv6 metadata/control-plane, first-word-zero IPv6, bracket/case/whitespace obfuscation, decimal/octal-looking octets that must fail closed, and DNS-rebind [public,private] multi-homing (deny-if-ANY). `controlPlaneCidrs` is the INJECTED AOA_CONTROL_PLANE_DENY_CIDRS fixture — deliberately PUBLIC ranges isPrivateIP would NOT catch — so a control-plane probe cannot vacuously pass on an empty deny set (proven by the injected-load-bearing test). Bound to the REAL classifier in server/src/__tests__/egress-bypass.test.ts and re-derived independently in scripts/check-egress-bypass-vectors.mjs.

denyVectors.name: metadata_hex_mapped_ipv6
denyVectors.note: ::ffff:a9fe:a9fe is the HEX spelling of ::ffff:169.254.169.254 == 169.254.169.254. Must canonicalize to family-4 or it evades the family-4 metadata CIDR.

denyVectors.name: metadata_hex_mapped_ipv6_uppercase
denyVectors.note: Case-obfuscated hex spelling of the IMDS address — parseIp lowercases before matching.

denyVectors.name: metadata_bracketed_mapped_ipv6
denyVectors.note: Bracket-wrapped IPv4-mapped IMDS address — brackets are stripped before parsing.

denyVectors.name: control_plane_hex_mapped_public_ipv6
denyVectors.note: ::ffff:2d37:6301 == ::ffff:45.55.99.1 == 45.55.99.1, a PUBLIC control-plane IP (in the injected 45.55.0.0/16). isPrivateIP cannot catch a public IP — only the family-4 control_plane gate stands, and ONLY if the hex form is canonicalized to family-4.

denyVectors.name: control_plane_public_ipv4_injected_only
denyVectors.note: 45.55.99.1 is a genuinely PUBLIC address; it is denied ONLY because of the injected controlPlaneCidrs. With an empty deny set it would ALLOW — the injected-load-bearing test asserts exactly that, so this vector can never vacuously pass.

denyVectors.name: decimal_ip_literal_fail_closed
denyVectors.note: 2130706433 is the 32-bit decimal form of 127.0.0.1. It is NOT dotted-quad, so parseIp returns null and the classifier fails CLOSED to private (never allow).

denyVectors.name: octal_looking_octet_fail_closed
denyVectors.note: 0177.0.0.1 has a 4-digit first octet that the strict /^\d{1,3}$/ octet rule rejects → parseIp null → fail-closed private.

denyVectors.name: dns_rebind_public_then_private
denyVectors.note: DNS-rebind: an allowlisted host resolves to [public, private]. Deny-if-ANY resolved address is unsafe (the attacker connects to the private one).

denyVectors.name: dns_rebind_public_then_metadata
denyVectors.note: Multi-homed rebind whose second address is the cloud metadata endpoint — metadata precedence over the public first address.

denyVectors.name: empty_resolution_fail_closed
denyVectors.note: An unverifiable/empty resolution cannot be proven public → fail-closed private.

denyVectors.name: non_allowlisted_public_host_default_deny
denyVectors.note: A genuinely PUBLIC, non-allowlisted host resolving to a public IP: the default-deny allowlist gate returns not_allowlisted BEFORE any address classification, exercising the allowlist-bypass path within the DEP-008 corpus itself (not only DAT-005's).

denyVectors.name: non_https_scheme_default_deny
denyVectors.note: A non-https spelling of an otherwise-allowlisted host: isAllowlisted rejects any non-https scheme, so default-deny returns not_allowlisted.
